**The US government is increasingly likely to shut down next week. Here's why.**
The U.S. federal government is on track to shut down next week because Republicans and Democrats have failed to agree on a funding plan before the current appropriations expire on September 30, 2025. Republicans control the House, Senate and presidency, but in the Senate most major bills require 60 votes to overcome the filibuster; with only 53 Republican senators, they need Democratic support to pass a funding bill.
